repos_data.description: MCP server that connects AI agents to your running Neovim instance via msgpack-RPC — no plugins required.
Local-first MCP memory layer for AI coding assistants; persistent cross-session memory, stored entirely on your machine

repo_meta_data.description: world-model-mcp is a signed audit memory server for AI coding agents, delivered as an MCP tool. Every event Ed25519-signed and Merkle-chained; offline-verifiable against pinned public keys. Hosted platform with hybrid post-quantum signing at etch.systems.
